fact: On 20 August 2025 Cameroon's Minister of Posts and Telecommunications opened the 3rd extraordinary session of the conference of the Assembly of Telecommunications Regulators of Central Africa (ARTAC) at the headquarters of Cameroon's regulator in Yaoundé.
title: Minette Libom Li Likeng : “L’Afrique centrale doit bâtir un marché numérique intégré, inclusif et souverain”
